=== Possibly faulty data ===
* [[List of SWCCG tournaments]] gives this event as "July 2004" with no site; the convention ran 30 July – 1 August 2004 at Vigilant Fire Company #2, Columbia, Pennsylvania. Which day the winning decks were played is not stated.
